leadText: Rodger Parsons is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . From seasons one through six, he was credited as Ken Gates.
plainText:
Rodger Parsons is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . From seasons one through six, he was credited as Ken Gates.

==Biography==
Parsons was born on October 19, 1943. He is a graduate of New York University and holds a BFA degree in Television, Motion Pictures, Radio. Parsons was a voice actor on starting with the first season, primarily being the narrator. He left halfway through the sixth season due to a payment dispute , but returned when took over dubbing and distribution of the series starting with the ninth season.

==Trivia==
Parsons' first name is misspelled as Roger in the credits of several seasons.
Parsons is a member of Voices for Fosters alongside fellow Pokémon voice actresses Sarah Natochenny and Lisa Ortiz.
